'''Fissona''' was a young [[Tarasin]] and was a troublemaker within [[Hiironi irstat]]. Prior to the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]], when Fissona was nine years of age, he was often caught and punished for his misdeeds; despite being the grandson of [[Cryalira]].
